dest:taveuni:header.note: Weak: Taveuni coastline with bougainvillea and palms, Matagi on the horizon; a scenic view but not a town or island panorama. Local copy is 1920 px wide (Commons resize); original 5262 px. Film-scan look and no date in the lens data: judge must check the date (pre-2000 fails). Only Commons-licensed option found; wrong-place risk low (file named for Taveuni).

dest:taveuni:why3.note: Des Voeux Peak / Tagimoucia on the official Taveuni things-to-do page: a cloud-capped peak in forest, the climb itself. Exactly 1280 px wide (the minimum) and 2.4:1, so it crops to the 1.6:1 card width-wise; the page's own header image, not a master file.
